verdict.rationale: Adyen publishes an official adyen-openapi GitHub repository and recommends importing the API definition into Postman, which gives developers a downloadable, machine-readable spec. The 404s at guessed docs.adyen.com OpenAPI paths only show the spec is not hosted at those URLs; they do not contradict the GitHub distribution. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that the repo covers the risk-specific APIs (Disputes API, Referrals API), in-depth first-party docs on spec versioning and download, and independent hands-on corroboration.
